videos.title: What Are Subagents? Explained in 4 Minutes
videos.summary: Jess Weng, Education Engineer at LangChain, explains subagents in Deep Agents, LangChain's open-source agent harness. A subagent takes one task from the main agent, does the messy work in its own fresh context window, and sends back only the result, so the main agent's context stays focused on the big picture. She also shows how subagents run in parallel or in the background, and how offloading and summarization keep each subagent's own context lean. Chapters: 0:00 Why long tasks overload an age

videos.title: How to Search for Exoplanets
videos.summary: Two amateur astronomers, Kevin Bond and Ethan Byrd, independently found signals that could point to planets around distant stars. They knew you didn't need your own telescope for this kind of hunt. Kevin used Codex and Ethan used Astra to search public telescope data for tiny, recurring dips in starlight that an orbiting planet can cause. Both found signals worth a second look. https://openai.com/index/searching-for-distant-planets-with-astra/
